related.title: LevelDB：LSM 層級、排序合併與 tombstone
related.titleEn: LevelDB: LSM levels, merging and tombstones
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付reader-timeline.csv與可見性表；此watermark練習不是SQLite所有checkpoint模式的完整實作。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver reader-timeline.csv and visibility tables; this watermark exercise does not implement every SQLite checkpoint mode. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 以(key,sequence,type,value)排序，逐鍵比較來源run；將刪除與空字串區分。
related.differenceEn: Sort by(key,sequence,type,value), compare source runs per key and distinguish deletion from an empty string.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
WAL讀者保留開始讀取時的可見邊界；checkpoint不能任意越過仍需舊狀態的讀者。長讀取會影響回收。
本課數值核對：100*4096 = 409600 total_page_payload_B；另一項核對：(100-40)*4096 = 245760 uncheckpointed_page_payload_B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

LSM將新寫入放在較新序號，合併時按鍵與序號決定可見版本；tombstone不能在仍有舊版本時過早丟棄。
本課數值核對：100+100-20 = 180 records；另一項核對：10/180 = 0.0555555555556 ratio。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
WAL readers retain a visibility boundary from read start; checkpointing cannot disregard readers needing older state. Long readers affect reclamation.
Numeric audit: 100*4096 = 409600 total_page_payload_B; second audit: (100-40)*4096 = 245760 uncheckpointed_page_payload_B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

LSM updates carry newer sequences; merging chooses visibility by key and sequence. Tombstones cannot be dropped while older versions may remain visible.
Numeric audit: 100+100-20 = 180 records; second audit: 10/180 = 0.0555555555556 ratio. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: JVM：堆疊位元碼與驗證器
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付reader-timeline.csv與可見性表；此watermark練習不是SQLite所有checkpoint模式的完整實作。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver reader-timeline.csv and visibility tables; this watermark exercise does not implement every SQLite checkpoint mode. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 逐指令列pc、操作、前stack、後stack；add與mul各消耗兩個int再推一個。
related.differenceEn: Trace PC, operation and before/after stacks; add and mul each consume two integers and push one.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
WAL讀者保留開始讀取時的可見邊界；checkpoint不能任意越過仍需舊狀態的讀者。長讀取會影響回收。
本課數值核對：100*4096 = 409600 total_page_payload_B；另一項核對：(100-40)*4096 = 245760 uncheckpointed_page_payload_B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

operand stack的型別與高度必須沿控制流一致；位元碼驗證與執行結果是兩層不同條件。
本課數值核對：(2+3)*4 = 20 result；另一項核對：max(1,2) = 2 slots。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
WAL readers retain a visibility boundary from read start; checkpointing cannot disregard readers needing older state. Long readers affect reclamation.
Numeric audit: 100*4096 = 409600 total_page_payload_B; second audit: (100-40)*4096 = 245760 uncheckpointed_page_payload_B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Operand-stack types and heights must agree across control flow; bytecode verification and the eventual computed result are separate conditions.
Numeric audit: (2+3)*4 = 20 result; second audit: max(1,2) = 2 slots. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
